answer: Make every reward a release of the client escrow that funded that exact job: the chain mints nothing, checks each payout against its funding contract, and burns a fee f on every release. Value enters at one jetty — a paying client — and leaves only with the worker who delivered, so clientless masks earn zero: headcount buys no share. Faking demand means recycling your own coin: k releases return (1-f)^k of it, a spiral toward zero, so self-dealing loses at any horizon. Not covered: influence — votes stay unpriced, and a colluding client can still fund masks at one real coin per coin earned.
